mito -use json,collections src.cel
! stderr .
cmp stdout want.txt

-- src.cel --
"{\"n\": 999999999999999999999}".decode_json_string_numbers().as(o,
	{
		"as_cel_value": o,
		"n_is_string": type(o.n) == string,
		"encoded_json_text": o.encode_json(),
		"round_trip_text_equal": o.encode_json() == "{\"n\":999999999999999999999}",
		"rebuilt_map_encoded": {"n": o.n}.encode_json(),
		"nested_map":      "{\"a\":{\"n\":999999999999999999999}}".decode_json_string_numbers().a.encode_json(),
		"nested_list":     "{\"l\":[1,2]}".decode_json_string_numbers().l.encode_json(),
		"top_level_list":  "[1,2]".decode_json_string_numbers().encode_json(),
		"entries_map":     "{\"entries\":[{\"id\":123,\"n\":999999999999999999999}]}".decode_json_string_numbers().entries.map(e, e.encode_json()),
		"stream_map":      "{\"a\":1}\n{\"b\":2}".decode_json_stream_string_numbers().map(e, e.encode_json()),
		"stream_encode":   "{\"a\":1}\n{\"b\":2}".decode_json_stream_string_numbers().encode_json(),
	}
)
-- want.txt --
{
	"as_cel_value": {
		"n": "999999999999999999999"
	},
	"encoded_json_text": "{\"n\":999999999999999999999}",
	"entries_map": [
		"{\"id\":123,\"n\":999999999999999999999}"
	],
	"n_is_string": true,
	"nested_list": "[1,2]",
	"nested_map": "{\"n\":999999999999999999999}",
	"rebuilt_map_encoded": "{\"n\":\"999999999999999999999\"}",
	"round_trip_text_equal": true,
	"stream_encode": "[{\"a\":1},{\"b\":2}]",
	"stream_map": [
		"{\"a\":1}",
		"{\"b\":2}"
	],
	"top_level_list": "[1,2]"
}
